title: Scheduled low degree coefficient separation
statement: Let $n$ and $\ell$ be nonnegative integers, and let $\delta$ be rational with $0<\delta\le 1/2$. Write $N$ for the number of subsets of $[n]$ of size at most $\ell$, and set $m=2^\ell\bigl(N+\lceil\log_2\lceil 2/\delta\rceil\rceil\bigr)$, where the logarithmic ceiling is the least integer $k$ such that $2^k$ is at least its argument. Choose $m$ sign-cube inputs independently and uniformly, and identify each with a vector in $\mathbb F_2^n$ by the coordinatewise binary-to-sign correspondence. The probability that evaluation on these inputs fails to be injective on the space of $\mathbb F_2$-coefficient polynomials spanned by the squarefree monomials of degree at most $\ell$ is at most $\delta$.
hypotheses_covered: Uniform random sample of the specified size
